usage:
feedbai — user feedback for AI agents (Matrix, Bluesky)

Start here:
  feedbai                       This project: setup guide, or source status + new feedback since last run

Read:
  feedbai fetch                 Fetch feedback (all configured projects, or filter with --project/--source)
  feedbai sources               List sources and whether they can authenticate

Set up (writes feedbai.config.json at the project root; commit it):
  feedbai add matrix <room>               #alias:server, !id:server or matrix.to link [--join]
  feedbai add bluesky search <query>      Posts matching a query (needs account)
  feedbai add bluesky author <handle>     An account's posts and replies
  feedbai add bluesky thread <post-link>  Replies in one thread
  feedbai add bluesky mentions            Mentions/replies/quotes of your account (needs account)
  feedbai remove <source-id>
  feedbai init                            Only create the config [--id --name --repository]

Accounts (run in a real terminal: prompts for the secret):
  feedbai login matrix --user @you:matrix.org [--homeserver url] [--token]
  feedbai login bluesky --identifier you.bsky.social [--service url]

Listen (agents: run in the background; each stdout line is new feedback):
  feedbai watch                 Poll sources, print only new items [--interval 60 --max-interval 900]

Agents:
  feedbai skill                 Print the agent workflow (triage → issues/PRs)
  feedbai skill install         Link it into Claude Code, Codex and pi skill folders

Options:
  --as <agent>       Separate "last run" cursor per agent (or FEEDBAI_AGENT), e.g. --as claude
  --digest           Group by thread and shorten (automatic above 30 items per source)
  --since <when>     7d, 12h, 30m, ISO date, or "last" (default for bare feedbai)
  --limit <n>        Max items per source (default 50)
  --format <fmt>     md (default), json, ndjson
  --project <id>  --source <id>  --config <file>  --id <id>  --account <id>
  feedbai paths      Where config, secrets and state live

home.setup:
## Set it up

Agent: ask the user which channels to follow (offer the ones found above; use your multiple-choice question UI if you have one), then run the matching commands:

- Matrix room: `feedbai add matrix '#room:server'`
- Bluesky posts mentioning the project: `feedbai add bluesky search '{id}'`
- A Bluesky account's posts and replies: `feedbai add bluesky author <handle>`
- Mentions of the user's Bluesky account: `feedbai add bluesky mentions`
- One Bluesky thread: `feedbai add bluesky thread <post link>`

`add` creates feedbai.config.json at {root}; suggest committing it. Then run `feedbai` again.

Accounts: Matrix rooms and Bluesky search/mentions need one. The user runs `feedbai login matrix --user @them:matrix.org` or `feedbai login bluesky --identifier them.bsky.social` in their own terminal (it prompts for the secret). Never ask for passwords or tokens in chat. Matrix accounts must have joined the room (or add the source with `--join`).

Maintainers: add `"maintainers": ["@them:matrix.org", "them.bsky.social"]` to the project in feedbai.config.json; their messages are marked [maintainer] and are direction, everyone else's are feedback.

Full reference: `feedbai help` · agent workflow: `feedbai skill`

home.next:
## Next

- Keep listening during this session: run `feedbai watch --as {consumer}` as a background process; every line it prints is new feedback (Claude Code: run it with the Monitor tool or in the background).
- Older items: `feedbai --since 7d` (does not move the "last run" cursor)
- Triage workflow (feedback → issues → PRs): `feedbai skill`
- Add or remove channels: `feedbai add ...`, `feedbai remove <id>` · reference: `feedbai help`
watch.start: feedbai watch: {count} sources, cursor "{consumer}", every {interval}s (slower while quiet). New feedback is printed to stdout.
